## Testing Mode
RED

## Story DD Coverage
- dd-2: `grep -- '--artifact ' plugins/dso/skills/{preplanning,implementation-plan,sprint}/SKILL.md` returns zero matches for sub-agent-prompt handoffs (carve-outs for --artifact-file= and --artifacts-dir per epic scope)

## Description
Create tests/scratch/test-grep-zero-match.sh that runs the literal grep, filters out helper-script carve-outs (--artifact-file=, --artifacts-dir), asserts zero remaining matches. Script exits non-zero with diagnostic if any sub-agent-prompt --artifact handoff remains. Also verify the test detects a synthetic regression when --artifact <path> is injected into a fixture.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] bash tests/run-all.sh exits 0
  Verify: bash tests/run-all.sh
- [ ] Lint passes
  Verify: ruff check plugins/dso/scripts/*.py tests/**/*.py
- [ ] Script exits 0 against migrated tree
  Verify: bash tests/scratch/test-grep-zero-match.sh
- [ ] Script exits non-zero on synthetic regression
  Verify: bash tests/scratch/test-grep-zero-match.sh
- [ ] Script executable
  Verify: test -x tests/scratch/test-grep-zero-match.sh

## File Impact
| Path | Action |
|---|---|
| tests/scratch/test-grep-zero-match.sh | Create |

## Retry Budget
MAX_ATTEMPTS: 3 sonnet → opus → user.
